STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked bacon ≈ 540 kcal/100 g (pan-fried, fat rendered). 6 g x 5.4 = ~32 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A single thin strip on a large plate should be small, a few grams to around ten grams, and about 30–40 kcal fits what is visible.
